description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ConditionValidator class within the OpenMRS project, focusing on validating Condition objects.

classes.name: ConditionValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for ConditionValidator, testing validation logic for Condition objects in various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes ConditionValidator, Condition object, and Errors before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that validator throws IllegalArgumentException when given null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfClassOtherThanCondition
methods.description: Tests that validator throws IllegalArgumentException when given an object of wrong type.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenConditionWithNullConditionProperties
methods.description: Tests that errors are generated when condition properties are null.

methods.name: shouldPassIfConditionClassIsPassedWithRequiredConditionProperties
methods.description: Tests successful validation when a Condition with proper properties is provided.
